scope: retrospective daily-price-only study; no official forward-performance claim
availability_assumption: For simulation only, completed prior observed trading-session OHLC is usable at next observed session pre-open. Original available_at fields are preserved, not relabeled as verified.
selection: Minimize validation close MAE in bps; select candidate alpha, direct baseline alpha, and strongest baseline only on validation; keep all locked on final test.
update_rule: Expanding-window daily refit; all training labels strictly precede forecast date; include previously completed validation/test sessions as they become past.
wick_rule: Historical expanding mean of nonnegative upper/lower log wicks, shared by all models
limitations: No overnight or overseas features in the available cached datasets
Not a backtest of the legacy news/prompt predictor
TAIEX uses TEJ 2025 and TWSE 2026; December 2025 source overlap must match
TX data is one far-month contract, not a front-month rollover series
Publication/revision times are not historically verified
80% intervals and their calibration are not implemented
